title: Speculative Futures
department: School of Languages, Literatures and Cultures
description: Additional information: Open to all graduate students in all SLLC graduate programs. Accompanies the SLLC graduate student colloquium that explores the theme of speculative futures in a cross-disciplinary setting. Tackles a critical and methodological question from a particular discipline each week, and puts it in conversation with others. Builds an archive of critical readings and discussions that frame the colloquium, turning the thematic exploration into a rigorous learning experience.
